modernizationPaths.description: Replace JSP and Struts views with a React SPA backed by JAX-RS REST resources on the existing Tomcat/JEE stack. Reuse Hibernate entities and HospitalService behind DTO-based endpoints. Lowest disruption; the largest ecosystem and AI tooling support.
modernizationPaths.keyTechnicalChallenges: Replace scriptlet DAO calls with REST DTOs; extract listener logic from HttpServletRequest; add token or session auth plus server-side role checks; make HospitalService thread-safe; convert multipart upload and PDF streaming.

modernizationPaths.description: Rebuild the backend as Quarkus REST services with Hibernate ORM/Panache and a React SPA. Gains fast startup, container-native packaging and a modern developer experience, at the cost of a platform change from the Tomcat WAR.
modernizationPaths.keyTechnicalChallenges: Port javax to jakarta and Hibernate 5 to 6 with Oracle dialect; replace singleton listeners with CDI beans; introduce OIDC or JWT security; rewrite Jasper PDF streaming; redo Podman/Tomcat deployment as Quarkus containers.

modernizationPaths.description: Introduce a Vue 3 SPA (Pinia, Vue Router) consuming JAX-RS endpoints added on the current JEE/Tomcat backend. Incremental route-by-route migration of role dashboards with smaller learning curve for JSP teams.
modernizationPaths.keyTechnicalChallenges: Decouple JSP scriptlet data access into REST DTOs; map ActionType redirect flags to API responses; implement role-based route guards plus server-side authorization; handle multipart photo upload and PDF downloads; configure CORS and build pipeline.

modernizationPaths.description: Vue 3 SPA with a Quarkus REST backend using Panache and CDI. Delivers a lightweight modern stack with fast builds, but combines a frontend rewrite with a full backend platform migration.
modernizationPaths.keyTechnicalChallenges: Migrate javax to jakarta and Hibernate 5 to 6; replace Struts dispatcher and listeners with REST resources and CDI services; add JWT/OIDC with Pinia auth state; port Jasper reports; rework Oracle schema handling from hbm2ddl to Flyway.

modernizationPaths.description: Angular SPA with typed services and route guards calling JAX-RS endpoints on the existing JEE backend. Strong structure and TypeScript fit large role-based apps, but needs more up-front architecture than React or Vue.
modernizationPaths.keyTechnicalChallenges: Define DTO contracts and OpenAPI for about 30 operations; implement HttpInterceptor auth with role guards; replace scriptlet-driven lists with RxJS services and reactive forms; handle dynamic qualification rows, multipart upload and PDF blobs; Angular CLI and WAR build integration.

modernizationPaths.description: Angular SPA with a Quarkus REST backend. Most opinionated enterprise stack on both tiers, offering strong typing and cloud-native deployment but requiring the broadest rewrite and skill ramp-up.
modernizationPaths.keyTechnicalChallenges: Simultaneous frontend rewrite and javax to jakarta, Hibernate 6 and Quarkus migration; build OpenAPI-first contracts; implement OIDC with Angular guards and interceptors; replace shared Hibernate session; port Jasper and rebuild CI/CD and container deployment.
